name: resume control: the same new task with no prior session
description: Control for resume-cross-provider-new-task: the same cwd and task, but a fresh session. Its pass rate is the baseline the resume scenario is compared against. Its assertions must stay identical to the resume scenario's.
inputs: New task, unrelated to the assembly: read samples.tsv and tell me which sample IDs are in the treated condition. Answer with only those IDs, comma-separated.

mustNotMatch: ^\s*What do you want to work on next\?\s*$
